I teach and supervise students in the **Environmental Epidemiology** and **Environmental and Policy Impact Assessment** modules for the [Master of Public Health/Epidemiology/Health Data Analytics and Machine Learning programmes](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/school-public-health/study/postgraduate/masters/) at Imperial College London. 


## Masters project supervision
::: {.news}
- **2026**  Systematic review on the association between air pollution exposure and development of specific asthma phenotypes in childhood. 

- **2026**  Systematic review and meta-analysis on the association between prenatal air pollution exposure and chilhood astha development

- **2026**  Systematic review on the association between air pollution exposure and healthy ageing outcomes 

- **2025**  Literature review on the association between occupational microplastic exposure and health outcomes 
:::
